tide.method: First six-minute sample of the cached day with speed >=0.5 m/s and direction within 45 degrees of the documented phase; unspecified captions use local midnight without asserting a phase.

wind.note: 2.5 kn is the midpoint of the caption range 2–3 kn; null means unreported and the standardized trial uses still air.
